independence_statement: This B round used only B-agent instructions, plan/state/context files named in the task, and inspector_B_round1. It did not read current-S1/A or any A-round output.
polaris: Can I_phi be pre-registered from input-side spectroscopy, structure, and dephasing variables without leakage from bulk superconducting outputs?
framework: input-side zero-leakage coding plus linear observability audit

core_claim.statement: C_phi is executable only as a frozen, dimensionless observability score computed from pre-output input channels; it is not a superconducting mechanism and is not validated here.

forbidden_outputs: any threshold or inclusion rule chosen after opening bulk superconducting outputs

frozen_index.equation: I_phi = E_z2_meV * C_phi / (kB_meV_per_K * T_calc_K + hbarGamma_phi_meV + E_floor_meV)

E_z2_rule.raw_units: dimensionless spectral weight after beamline-specific intensity correction and normalization to total Ni-L edge spectral weight in the same scan
E_z2_rule.spectral_window: pre-output normal-state scan; integrate the declared dz2-sensitive component over EF +/- 0.35 eV, or over the closest preregistered instrument-accessible window listed in P0 before unblinding
E_z2_rule.normalization_note: Raw spectral weight is not treated as an energy until multiplied by the frozen E_z2_ref_meV.

allowed_sources: normal-state optical or THz Drude scattering rate above output unblinding
normal-state ARPES linewidth from a preregistered momentum/energy window
normal-state Raman or pump-probe dephasing scale if the method and window are sealed in P0
forbidden_sources: any fit including Tc or superconducting labels
Gamma_phi_rule.units: meV for hbar*Gamma_phi; if the instrument reports Gamma in s^-1, convert with hbar = 0.6582119569 meV*ps after converting Gamma to ps^-1

E_floor_rule.D_disorder_definition: preregistered disorder/inhomogeneity score from microstrain, mosaicity, impurity fraction, or pair-distribution-function residual; the exact selected column and calibration must be sealed in P0
E_floor_rule.purpose: prevents divergence and records ordinary disorder/structure as an input-side penalty without using output labels

a_caxis.W_caxis_raw_units: Ohm^-1 cm^-2 meV, equal to integral sigma1_c(omega) d(hbar omega)
a_caxis.frequency_window: 25 to 250 meV in the normal state, sealed before output unblinding

a_struct.B_struct_definition: frozen structural bridge score from apical-O or spacer geometry, tilt, and layer registry; exact formula must be in P0

singular_value_convention.svd: compute singular values of the 7x4 real matrix C using IEEE-754 float64; sort descending; sigma_min is the fourth and smallest singular value
singular_value_convention.zero_observability_limit: if any mandatory channel amplitude is exactly zero and no allowed replacement is sealed in P0, C_phi must be reported as 0 with missingness flags rather than tuned from outputs

C_phi_transfer_matrix.normalization_rationale: Each raw channel is converted to a dimensionless bounded row amplitude before entering C. The SVD therefore audits whether the whole input-side chain is observable, rather than letting a high-value single raw channel dominate through units.

missing_data_rules.pre_unblinding_only: All missingness decisions must be executed before opening forbidden outputs.
missing_data_rules.rule_1_no_output_imputation: No missing input may be imputed, weighted, excluded, or replaced using Tc, resistance, shielding, critical current, phase stiffness, or any derived phase label.
missing_data_rules.rule_2_censored_values: If an input is reported only as below detection limit, use one-half of the sealed detection limit and set censored=true; if above saturation, use the saturation limit and set censored=true.
missing_data_rules.rule_3_missing_mandatory_channel: If one mandatory channel is absent and no sealed alternative measurement is listed in P0 for that same channel, emit I_phi=null, C_phi=null, status='input_incomplete'. Do not drop the sample after seeing outputs.
missing_data_rules.rule_4_alternatives: Allowed alternatives must be channel-equivalent and sealed in P0 with their own units and normalization constants. A replacement cannot be selected because it improves correlation with outputs.
missing_data_rules.rule_5_rounding: Report normalized amplitudes, sigma_min, C_phi, and I_phi to 10 decimal places in machine labels; display tables may round to 4 significant digits.

deposited_artifacts_spec.deposit_time: before opening any forbidden output file or superconducting phase label
deposited_artifacts_spec.timestamp_source: UTC from the repository host or signed lab notebook clock; local timezone may be included but UTC is authoritative
deposited_artifacts_spec.canonical_json: sort object keys lexicographically, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8, LF line endings, decimal numbers emitted with the frozen precision stated in P0

artifacts.contents: frozen equations, row definitions, constants, windows, units, missing-data rules, baseline tests, code version
instrument, operator-blind sample ids, acquisition windows, detection limits, unit conversions, censored flags
sample_id, normalized amplitudes, sigma_min, C_phi, E_z2_meV, denominator_meV, I_phi, status
same samples scored by S_dz2 only, c-axis only, disorder/structure only, Gamma_phi only, and frozen I_phi
minimal recomputation script with no output-label inputs
path, SHA-256, byte size, timestamp_utc for every deposited artifact

pass_criteria.hashes: all pre-output artifact hashes match manifest.sha256.json
pass_criteria.numeric_tolerance: absolute error <= 5e-10 for normalized amplitudes, sigma_min, C_phi, denominator_meV, and I_phi when recomputed in float64
pass_criteria.label_tolerance: if labels are binned later, bin assignments must be bitwise identical to the sealed label file
pass_criteria.missingness: status fields and censored flags must be identical

auditor_recomputation.interpretation_limit: A recomputation pass proves only that the input-side encoder was frozen and reproducible; it does not validate predictive value.

three_sample_mock_packet.purpose: executable sanity packet for the preregistration format; not evidence for nickelate superconductivity
three_sample_mock_packet.anti_collapse_example: LP28-MOCK-002 has the highest S_dz2_raw but lower I_phi than LP28-MOCK-001 because c-axis weight, structure, disorder, and Gamma_phi weaken the full input-side chain. This is a format sanity check only.

baseline_collapse_tests.test_scope: run before output unblinding and store in baseline_scores.csv; compare score rankings only to the frozen I_phi ranking, not to superconducting outputs

baselines.collapse_flag: true if Spearman rank correlation with I_phi across sealed input samples is >= 0.95 and every discordant-pair test is absent
true if Spearman rank correlation with I_phi across sealed input samples is >= 0.95 and no sample pair is reversed by C_phi/Gamma/E_floor
true if this baseline reproduces all I_phi ranks up to auditor tolerance
true if this baseline reproduces all I_phi ranks up to auditor tolerance

required_discordant_pair_checks.condition: exists pair i,j with S_dz2_i > S_dz2_j but I_phi_i < I_phi_j
required_discordant_pair_checks.mock_result: present: LP28-MOCK-002 has higher S_dz2 than LP28-MOCK-001 but lower I_phi

required_discordant_pair_checks.condition: exists pair i,j with W_caxis_i > W_caxis_j but I_phi_i < I_phi_j
required_discordant_pair_checks.mock_result: present: LP28-MOCK-003 has lower W_caxis than LP28-MOCK-001 and lower I_phi; this mock does not by itself supply the reverse discordance

required_discordant_pair_checks.condition: exists pair i,j with B_struct_i/(1+D_disorder_i) > B_struct_j/(1+D_disorder_j) but I_phi_i < I_phi_j
required_discordant_pair_checks.mock_result: present: LP28-MOCK-003 has stronger structure/disorder score than LP28-MOCK-001 but lower I_phi

required_discordant_pair_checks.condition: exists pair i,j with lower hbarGamma_phi_i than hbarGamma_phi_j but I_phi_i < I_phi_j
required_discordant_pair_checks.mock_result: present: LP28-MOCK-003 has lower Gamma_phi than LP28-MOCK-001 but lower I_phi

baseline_collapse_tests.go_no_go_for_noncollapse: If real sealed inputs show that I_phi is rank-identical to any single-variable baseline and no preregistered discordant-pair check exists, S1 must report baseline collapse. That is a protocol failure mode, not validation.

claims.statement: C_phi can be defined as a dimensionless SVD observability score from four input-side channels with fixed units and normalization.
equations: C is the 7x4 matrix defined in C_phi_transfer_matrix.matrix_rows
assumptions: The four input channels are measured on the same sample before opening forbidden outputs.
P0 freezes all windows, constants, replacement rules, and code.
No threshold or hyperparameter is selected using superconducting outputs.

claims.statement: The audit packet can test whether I_phi collapses to S_dz2 only, c-axis weight only, disorder/structure only, or Gamma_phi only before any output comparison.
assumptions: Collapse is judged against the frozen I_phi labels, not against superconducting outcomes.
Real-sample noncollapse still would not validate predictive power; it only prevents trivial input-side reduction.

failed_jumps: Broad analogy to biological signaling was rejected because it did not specify units or an auditor-recomputable transfer matrix.
next_plan: Have an inspector audit the JSON for dimensional consistency, canonicalization, and whether the mock packet can be recomputed without output labels.
literature_needed: input-side normal-state c-axis optical spectral weight in layered nickelates; dz2-sensitive spectroscopy normalization; normal-state dephasing or scattering rates; structural apical-O/spacer disorder metrics
